title: 第2章 有三尖两刃刀和黑狗才是正经的杨二郎
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

约莫两刻钟后，祁澜便领着一行人，戴着斗笠，用蓑衣遮住皮甲，在雨中驱赶着几只猪羊鸡鸭，来到了那个毗邻大泽的小渔村。

渔村之民，已经带着财货临时迁入城邑之中，是以冷冷清清，并无什么人气。

“阿福，可有闻到哪处腥气重？”

老默牵着一条皮毛油光水亮的黄毛细腰犬，在渔村附近的河岸，四处嗅着气味，搜寻着踪迹。

“话说二郎，你就没想过也养一条狗吗？你若是想，我可为你寻一只黑犬来。”

祁澜跟在后面，冲着杨戬道。

后者一脸纳闷地握着一把长柄兵器，看向祁澜。

“澜兄，你为我特地造这奇特的枪刃也就罢了，还算好用，可养狗这事，我却真没兴趣。而且为什么是黑犬，是有什么说法吗？”

祁澜却是嘿嘿一笑，不再作答。

杨二郎，就是要三尖两刃刀和哮天犬才对味嘛！

现在虽然还没成为那个赫赫有名的清源妙道真君，但这并不妨碍他想帮杨戬先搞出这一身行头。

可惜的是，杨戬现在并没有想养狗的想法，也不知道那哮天犬，什么时候才会出现。

“少君，有情况，那大鱓应当就在这附近。”

老默牵着的黄毛犬忽然停了下来，一脸警惕地拱起身子，冲着这块滩涂低声呜呜咆哮。

“流水能带走气味，但在这岸边，还是能寻到，此处腥味较之他处更浓，想来那大鱓多是在此处上岸，掠夺人畜。”

祁澜微微点头。

“那便依计行事。”

于是很快，几只鸡鸭便被当场宰杀，在湖边放血，又临时搭了个棚子，燃炭生火，一边取暖，一边烤着鸡鸭。

随着牲畜的血液传入水中，不过片刻，湖水表面，便荡漾起阵阵波纹。

半个光滑扁平的脑袋，顿时从湖面升起，两只黑色的眼睛，注视着岸上生灵的一举一动。

而此时，老默带来的那条黄狗，也再次冲着湖面发出了叫喊。

下一瞬间，水浪掀起，腥气滔天。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

About two-quarters of an hour later, Qi Lan led a group of people, wearing bamboo hats and covering their leather armor with raincoats, driving a few pigs, sheep, chickens and ducks in the rain to the small fishing village adjacent to Daze.

The people of the fishing village have temporarily moved into the city with their belongings, so it is deserted and not popular.

"Afu, can you smell the fishy smell anywhere?"

Lao Mo led a thin-waisted yellow-haired dog with shiny fur, sniffing around and searching for traces on the river bank near the fishing village.

"Speaking of which, Erlang, haven't you ever thought about getting a dog? If you do, I can find a black dog for you."

Qi Lan followed behind and said to Yang Jian.

The latter held a long-handled weapon with a puzzled look on his face and looked at Qi Lan.

"Brother Lan, you just made this strange gun blade just for me. It's pretty useful, but I'm really not interested in raising a dog. And why is it a black dog? Is there any explanation?"

Qi Lan smiled and did not answer any more.

Yang Erlang just needs a three-pointed two-edged sword and a roaring dog!

Although he has not yet become the famous Qingyuan Miao Dao Zhenjun, this does not prevent him from wanting to help Yang Jian get this outfit first.

It's a pity that Yang Jian has no idea of ​​raising a dog now, and he doesn't know when the roaring dog will appear.

"Young Master, if there is any situation, Da Qi should be nearby."

The yellow-haired dog held by Lao Mo suddenly stopped, raised its body with a wary expression, and growled lowly at the beach.

"Flowing water can take away the smell, but you can still find it on this shore. The fishy smell here is stronger than elsewhere. I think the big phoenix came ashore here to plunder people and animals."

Qi Lan nodded slightly.

"Then we'll act according to the plan."

So soon, several chickens and ducks were slaughtered on the spot, and their blood was bled by the lake. A temporary shed was built, and charcoal was used to make a fire. While keeping warm, the chickens and ducks were roasted.

As the livestock's blood flows into the water, within a moment, ripples appear on the surface of the lake.

Half of a smooth and flat head suddenly rose from the lake, with two black eyes watching every move of the creatures on the shore.

At this time, the yellow dog brought by Lao Mo also barked at the lake again.

The next moment, the water waves stirred up, and the smell was overwhelming.
